meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进行蛋白质序列建模与结构预测
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正从事蛋白质相关的生物信息研究
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and analyze sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're doing protein-related bioinformatics research

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 esm SDK 的写法帮你写代码：用 ESM3 生成或补全蛋白序列、预测结构、按功能注释生成，用 ESMC 算蛋白嵌入，也能经 Forge/Biohub 调用云端模型。
howto.when: 当你直接使用 esm Python SDK、ESM3/ESMC 模型 ID，或 Forge/Biohub 推理客户端等场景时触发。

say.text: 用 ESM3 把这条序列的掩码位补全，输出完整序列。
say.note: 走 esm3-open 本地权重或 Forge 客户端。

say.text: 给这个 PDB 结构做反向折叠，设计一条能折叠成它的序列。
用 ESMC 算这几条蛋白序列的嵌入，返回 embeddings。
say.note: 逐条 encode 后取 embeddings。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude writes esm SDK code for you: ESM3 sequence generation and completion, structure prediction, function-conditioned design, ESMC embeddings, and hosted Forge/Biohub inference.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work directly with the esm Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, and similar cases.

say_en.text: Complete the masked positions in this sequence with ESM3 and print the full sequence.
say_en.note: Uses local esm3-open weights or the Forge client.

say_en.text: Inverse-fold this PDB structure: design a sequence that folds into it.
say_en.note: Runs the structure track with temperature 0.7.

say_en.text: Compute ESMC embeddings for these protein sequences.
say_en.note: Encodes each sequence and returns embeddings.
